text:
Predicates:
ArtificiallySelected(x) ::: x is artificially selected.
BredBack(x) ::: x is bred-back.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Resemble(x, y) ::: x resembles y.
Extinct(x) ::: x is extinct.
HeckCattle(x) ::: x is Heck cattle.
Aurochs(x) ::: x is an aurochs.
Premises:
∀x (HeckCattle(x) → Animal(x)) ::: Heck cattle are animals.
∀x (Aurochs(x) → Animal(x)) ::: Aurochs are animals.
∃x (Animal(x) ∧ BredBack(x) ∧ Resemble(x, y) ∧ Animal(y) ∧ Extinct(y)) ::: Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct.
BredBack(heckCattle1920s) ::: Heck cattle were bred-back in the 1920s to resemble the aurochs.
Conclusion:
∃x (HeckCattle(x) ∧ ArtificiallySelected(x)) ::: Some Heck cattle are artificially selected.
